name: Feedback & Abuse Reports API
description: Public endpoints for submitting feedback and abuse reports, checking public report status, and listing enabled report types.

category.name: Support
category.description: Public feedback and abuse report endpoints.

POST /feedback_abuse/submit.name: Submit feedback or abuse report.
POST /feedback_abuse/submit.description: Accepts multipart/form-data and returns `{ok, public_id, id}` on success.

GET /feedback_abuse/status/@publicId.name: Read public report status.
GET /feedback_abuse/status/@publicId.description: Returns the public status for a submitted report by public_id.

GET /feedback_abuse/types.name: List enabled report types.
GET /feedback_abuse/types.description: Returns the report types currently enabled in module configuration.

OPTIONS /feedback_abuse/@any.name: CORS preflight for embedded report forms.
OPTIONS /feedback_abuse/@any.description: Responds to browser CORS preflight requests for embedded feedback and abuse forms.
